name: Unbidden Recklessness
description: Every ounce of your wild rampage is used without restraint or care for the danger it puts you in.
effect:
All Moves the User uses become Recoil Moves. All recoil damage to the User is rounded up. The User may ignore effects that would prevent them from taking recoil damage on their turn. All moves that already have the Recoil tag OR inflict Crashout effect damage instead deal recoil damage equal to 1/2 the damage dealt, instead of 1/3. In addition, these attacks deal 2 additional flat damage. All recoil and Crashout effect damage taken adds to your Rage Bar. In addition, when you take damage you add 1/3 of the damage taken after defenses to your Rage Bar. All instances of adding to the Rage Bar, either from Recoil or Damage taken are rounded down and always either cause a minimum of 1 damage or increase your bar by 1.  Your Rage Bar is equal to your Vitality + Insight.

When your Rage Bar is full, you enter a state of unrestrained power, In this state you instead heal from all instances of Recoil, however you take an additional 3 Damage from all attacks (only applied to the First Hit in a Multi-Hit Moves, and after any Critical Damage has been applied before defenses). You may enter/exit this state at the start of your turn while your Rage Bar is full.
